events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Loss
events.blurb: Commemorating the anniversary of Tupac Shakur's death in Las Vegas; he would have been 55.

angles.name: Impact and Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot on this day in 1996. His music and message continue to resonate decades later.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of rock legend Jimi Hendrix's passing; he would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar Genius
angles.copy: On this day, we remember Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar visionary who redefined rock music. His influence is still heard today.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69. That iconic cover and those timeless tracks – still sounds incredible.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders shaped a generation.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis and solo artist, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's still a rock 'n' roll star.

events.title: Imagine's Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: On this day in 1971, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song and album that continues to inspire hope and peace around the world.

events.title: iPod's Groundbreaking Debut
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, the first iPod dropped! Remember '1,000 songs in your pocket'? It truly revolutionised how we carried our tunes.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy and timeless music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary actor and comedian, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled.

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Diverse Sounds
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that showed every side of the Fab Four.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury; he would have been 80.

angles.name: Unforgettable Performer
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incredible Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy with Queen remain unmatched. He would have been 80.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Innovative Sound
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant evolution in their sound and songwriting.
